decisions.reason: Cleaning soap is a low-cost accessory that supports the core flooring business and the firm's maintenance offering.
Maintenance oil complements the oiled parquet range and generates recurring accessory sales at little cost.
The oiled-floor care product fits the care system, though it overlaps somewhat with the soap and oil, so consolidation is possible but unlikely soon.
An underlay with moisture protection is a standard installation accessory that buyers and installers need with floating floors.
High density underlay foam extends the accessory range for different performance needs, with minimal cost to keep listed.
Oak parquet is the core of a wood flooring producer's range and in strong demand.
